pages.title: Max and Luna · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a sunny Saturday morning at a big dog park in Portland. Dogs of all sizes run and bark happily. Nico walks in with his dog Max on a leash. Max pulls forward, full of energy. A woman with a brown dog smiles at him. Her name is Ivy.
“Hi! What a cute dog! What is his name?” says Ivy. “Thanks! His name is Max. What a beautiful dog!” says Nico. “Thank you. Her name is Luna. She is very friendly.” says Ivy.

verbs.note: Love = adorar. Regular: loved. Quase não se usa no -ing: veja a forma ao lado.

items.why: Com she, o verbo leva -s: plays.
Com we, a forma base: keep.

solo: Aluno responde; você explica o porquê.
group: Cada aluno responde antes de ver a correção.
Explique o “por quê” de cada resposta em uma frase.
extra90: Peça que digam a resposta em voz alta com a frase inteira.
answers: Yesterday I ___. → ran
She ___ every day. → plays
He is ___ now. → loving
We ___ every day. → keep
